summary.text: Jim Summers is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 20 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.
Summers is a business executive and U.S. Navy veteran, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: James Summers served in the U.S. Navy from 1990 to 1998.

He earned an associate degree in accounting/finance from Nashua Community College and bachelor's and master's degrees in business administration, plus a master's in organizational leadership, from Southern New Hampshire University, and a doctorate in business administration from Liberty University.

His career experience includes owning Exigere Networks and working as its CEO, a network pre-sales engineer with Cisco, an IT manager with Black Diamond Networks, and a senior technical analyst with JPMorgan Chase.
Summers previously represented Hillsborough 26 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2010 to 2012, and Ballotpedia lists his current tenure as beginning in 2022.
